description: Variation of conditions 2 (Approved Drawings) and 3 (External Material Details) to allow the following:*Repositioning of Roof Dormer and Rooflight*Additional Rear Elevation Window*Replacement of approved back- framed glazing to beige finish to Ground Floor Rear Glazing Material*Dormer Window Revisions*Front Garden Boundary Treatment*Front and rear elevations to restore original brick by removing render*Green roof and air-conditioning unit to ground floor extension roofof Householder application reference 25/1939 dated 28/10/2025 for "Demolition of rear storage and erection of single storey rear and side infill extension with excavation and lowering of rear ground floor area, rear dormer window with 1x front rooflight, replacement of 2x first floor side windows with 1x window, replacement of all existing windows with white timber windows, replacement roof covering, bin storage space to front and soft and hard landscaping to the dwellinghouse"
